description: Turn a list you wrote for the user (groceries, packing, a recipe's ingredients, who brings what) into a link that opens it pre-filled on OrtakListe. The user reviews it, unticks anything they don't need and creates a real-time shared list with one tap; they share a room code with family or friends, no account needed. Nothing is created until the user confirms. Give the returned URL to the user as a clickable link.

quantity.description: Optional quantity or detail, e.g. '2 litres' or '1 pack'.

language.description: Language for titles, descriptions and links: tr, en, es, de or fr. Use the user's language.

note.description: Optional note shown above the items: a date, a meeting point, recipe steps.

name: create_shared_list_link
title: Create a shared list link
